source.name: Football Fashion: Sweden World Cup 2026 adidas Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. Named-press kit launch write-up: the shirt carries only the SvFF crest and the adidas logo, 'SVERIGE' at the back collar, blue shorts and blue socks — no commercial sponsor on any placement, consistent with Football Shirt Culture's launch write-up and the SVFF shop product description. SvFF's press release (15 March 2023, via Mynewsdesk) names adidas exclusive supplier of match and training clothing to all Swedish national teams through 2030.
source.quote: The Swedish FA (Svenska Fotbollförbundet, SvFF) crest appears on the chest, while the adidas logo sits opposite in matching blue tones.

summary: adidas home kit for the 2026 international cycle. No commercial sponsors: the launch write-ups describe only the SvFF crest and adidas branding on the shirt, 'SVERIGE' at the back collar, with plain blue shorts and socks.
